def check_permissions(user: dict) -> bool:
    if not user.get("is_active"):
        return False
    return user.get("role") == "admin"


def maybe_find_item(items: list[dict], target_id: str) -> dict | None:
    for item in items:
        if item["id"] == target_id:
            return item
    return


def log_and_continue(msg: str) -> None:
    print(f"[INFO] {msg}")


def set_flag(flags: dict, key: str, value: bool) -> None:
    flags[key] = value
    if not value:
        return


def process_if_valid(data: dict):
    if "key" not in data:
        return
    value = data["key"]
    if value < 0:
        return
    print(f"Processing {value}")
